note: Web bundle 8 - pictures, a folder check that speaks up, and error reports home. Four things, all from Joshua on 2026-10-30: (1) Tap a picture in a book and it opens on its own full screen, fitted so the whole picture is visible; it scrolls and pans so every part is reachable, one tap zooms it to full size, and the X in the top-right corner closes it (a tap or the Back button also closes it) and returns to the exact place in the book. (2) The automatic folder check on open could spend its one attempt before the phone side was ready and never try again - it now retries until a scan actually starts, and when a check (automatic or manual) adds books, the library says so in a notice naming each book: '[title] is now part of your library.' Nothing added, nothing said. A damaged book in a folder can no longer wedge the scan half-finished: a book that will not parse in 30 seconds is counted unreadable and the scan completes. (3) Errors now report silently and automatically to the same Player Reports inbox as the game and the editors, as 'Reader Report' - folder scans that cannot reach a folder, files that cannot be read, books that will not open, session errors; each distinct failure reports once, and reports queue on the phone while offline and send on a later launch. The scrolling reading view from bundle 7 is unchanged.
